Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in interpreting the initial WebSurfer results. In Step 1, the Planner incorrectly stated that the search results indicated Maxeda was owned by "Kohlberg & Company (Kohlberg)." The WebSurfer's output clearly stated "Kohlberg Kravis Roberts & Co." (KKR). By misidentifying the firm as "Kohlberg & Company" (a different entity) instead of KKR, the Planner introduced a factual error that led to subsequent confusion and unnecessary iterations to resolve a discrepancy that did not exist. This premature and incorrect interpretation of the primary source data prevented the team from immediately confirming the correct answer (KKR) and instead created a false narrative of conflict between "Kohlberg & Company" and "KKR."
